cases.name: Karen Kaye Knippers
cases.about: She was known as Pulaski County Jane Doe and identified 40 years later in 2019.
cases.caseStatus: COLD CASE UNSOLVED; FORENSIC INVESTIGATIVE GENETIC GENEALOGY ID'D HER
cases.narrative: On 5/25/1981, police discovered her body in a low water crossing on Highway MM near Dixon, Missouri. She was found with pantyhose wrapped around her neck and facial trauma. She was found fully clothed.
